sbh3.2:3.4: Printed *paryeṣitā ca*; not in Xuanzang (T1579 juan 30); cf. 3.15.
sbh3.2:3.8: Printed *asamāhita-*; Xuanzang 等引地 = *samāhita-* (T1579 juan 30), as at 7.3.
sbh3.2:5.36: Printed *atrātmā*; read *atrāptāgamo* (Xuanzang 至教, T1579 juan 30; cf. 17.5).
sbh3.2:7.4: Printed *pratirūpam*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 實為 (T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.2:9.8: Printed *aśruvedanām*; read *aśru-svedam* (cf. sbh2.5:3.7; Xuanzang 淚, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.2:10.6: Printed *prāptapūyabhāvaṁ*; read *aprāptapūyabhāvaṁ* (Xuanzang 未至膿爛, T1579 juan 30; cf. 10.7).
sbh3.2:10.8: Printed *vimadrāmakaṁ*; read *vipaḍumakaṁ* (Xuanzang 爛壞, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.2:11.4: Printed *anyāsthīni*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 起骨勝解 (T1579 juan 30; cf. 12.6).
sbh3.2:11.5: Printed *arikṣakaraṅkam*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 骸骨 (T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.2:13.2: Printed *kāyasyāśubhā* (first clause); read *kāyasya śubhā* (Xuanzang 淨色相, T1579 juan 30; cf. 13.3).
sbh3.2:14.5: Printed *niḥsaraṇadharmaḥ*; read *saraṇadharmaḥ* 'with strife' (Xuanzang 有諍法, T1579 juan 30; cf. MN 139, mn139:13.3).
sbh3.2:15.3: Printed *aśubhā* (first); read *śubhā* (Xuanzang 淨色相, T1579 juan 30; cf. 13.2).
sbh3.2:15.8: Printed *aśubhā varṇanibhā … aśubhā satī*; read *śubhā … śubhā satī* (Xuanzang 此淨色相…雖有淨相, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.2:16.4: Printed *kaṇḍavara*; read *kaḍevara* 'body' (Xuanzang 身形, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.2:17.17: Printed *sā ca cintayitavyā*; read *sā na* (Xuanzang 不應思議, T1579 juan 30; cf. 5.37).
sbh3.2:21.21: Printed *māṣamātram*; read *nāmamātram* (Xuanzang 唯有名字, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.2:21.27: Printed *amitratraṁ*, corrupt (so *tram* at 22.5–6); the sense follows the context; Xuanzang differs (又亦不應不與怨家作善知識, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.2:22.4: Printed *amitrapakṣaḥ* (second); read *mitrapakṣaḥ* (Xuanzang 皆是我之親品, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.2:23.2: Printed *maraṇa* (23.2), *amaraṇa* (23.3); read *saraṇa*, *araṇa* (Xuanzang 有諍法, 無諍法, T1579 juan 30; cf. 14.5).
sbh3.2:25.5: Shukla's text lacks the *kāryakāraṇa*- and *upapattisādhana-yukti* here; Xuanzang has them (T1579 juan 30, 0453c27–0454a02).
sbh3.2:26.16: Printed *maraṇa*; read *saraṇa*, as at 14.5 (Xuanzang 廣說如前, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:26.19: Shukla's text lacks the *kāla* investigation here; Xuanzang has it (T1579 juan 31, 0454b05–09).
sbh3.2:26.30: Printed *sammohāsammoha-*; read *sammohaḥ sammoha-* (Xuanzang 發起愚癡；愚癡為先, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:27.2: Printed *saṁjñārtho*; read *bījārtho* (Xuanzang 種子義, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:27.7: Printed *rūpagatāsphuṭālakṣaṇaḥ*; MS *rūpagatāsphuṭalakṣaṇaḥ*, i.e. *rūpagata-asphuṭa-* 'not filled by form' (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (74) n. 2).
sbh3.2:27.11: Printed *maraṇa*; read *saraṇa*, as at 14.5 (Xuanzang 廣說如前, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:28.1: Printed *-ālambananicaya-*, corrupt, and not rendered; 27.1 has *-ālambanavipaśyanā-* (Xuanzang 毘鉢舍那, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:28.13: Printed *pravṛddhi-*; read *pravṛtti-* (Xuanzang 轉). Printed *mahāśravaṇā*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 及所依止 (T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:28.14: Printed *maraṇadharma*; read *saraṇadharma*, as at 14.5 (Xuanzang 廣說如前, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:28.22: Printed *pratyātmajñānānusāriko*; read *pratyātmajñānam ānumāniko*, as at 27.20 (Xuanzang 比度法, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:30.17: Printed *na prayuktasya … nābhīkṣṇaṁ*; read *prayuktasya … abhīkṣṇaṁ* (Xuanzang 雖…勤修加行，而…數數現行, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:30.19: Printed *tat ca*; read *na tac* (Xuanzang 不能令心速疾得定, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:30.23: Printed *tatprāstāreṇa bhāreṇa*; read *tatprāgbhāreṇa* (Xuanzang 不全臨入, T1579 juan 31, where all three terms are negated).
sbh3.2:30.30: Printed *nityakālasya na karoty*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 恒常思惟，修無常想 (T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:31.1: Shukla's text lacks the definition of *aviparītaprayogatā* and the heading of *kālaprayogatā*; Xuanzang has them (T1579 juan 31, 0456a05–10).
sbh3.2:31.2: Printed text omits *vipaśyanānimittaṁ* (cf. 31.4); Xuanzang has it (觀相, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:31.12: Printed *ūrdhvaṁ vā*; read *auddhatyā-* (*auddhatyābhiśaṅkini*, as 32.9 *līnatvābhiśaṅkini*; Xuanzang 或恐掉舉時, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:32.2: Printed *śamathapakṣyaṁ*; read *vipaśyanāpakṣyaṁ* (Xuanzang 毘鉢舍那品, T1579 juan 31; cf. 31.9).
sbh3.2:32.4: Printed *cetaḥśamathabimbayogaḥ*; read *cetaḥśamathaprayogaḥ* (Xuanzang 加行, T1579 juan 31; cf. 31.11).
sbh3.2:32.5: Shukla's text lacks the first clause, the sunk mind, the pair to 31.12; Xuanzang has it (心沈沒時，或恐沈沒時, T1579 juan 31, 0456b01–02).
sbh3.2:32.12: Printed *prasaśaṭhasvarasaṁvāhitā*; read *praśaṭhasvarasavāhitā* (Xuanzang 調柔正直任運轉性, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:32.16: Printed *-pakṣālayau lauddhatya-*; read *-pakṣe layauddhatya-* (cf. 31.12, 32.9; Xuanzang 掉舉, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:33.1: Printed *upekṣālakṣaṇā* before *upalakṣaṇaprayogatā*; not in Xuanzang (解了加行, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:33.4: Printed *samāhitabhūmikā-*; read *asamāhitabhūmika-* (Xuanzang 不定地, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:33.6: Printed *aprativā bhāṇiṇī ca* (33.6), *prahāsair* and *rupī* (33.7); read *aprativāṇī ca prahāṇe … bahulaṁ viharati* (cf. AN 2.5, an2.5:1.2; Xuanzang 修斷無廢…多住希求, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:33.15: Printed *avidūrā*; read *avidhurā* (Xuanzang 不捨其軛, T1579 juan 31; cf. 30.4).
sbh3.2:34.5: *Vibhāvanā* 'dispelling' the sign that has been resolved upon, the counterpart of *adhimokṣa* (35.14; Xuanzang 除遣, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:34.7: Printed *sarvanimittavaipulyena*; read *sarvanimittavaimukhyena* (Xuanzang 背一切相, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:35.1: Printed *nirnimitte*; read *sanimitte* (Xuanzang 有相, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:35.5: Printed *muktaṁ bhavati*; read *na muktaṁ* (Xuanzang 不捨、不取, T1579 juan 31; cf. 35.6).
sbh3.2:35.17: Printed *na janvandhasya*; read *na jātv asya* (Xuanzang 永無, T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:35.19: Printed *mahadgatapramāṇaṁ*; read *mahadgatam apramāṇaṁ* (Xuanzang 廣大、無量, T1579 juan 31; cf. 35.20).
sbh3.2:35.20: Printed *pramāṇam eva … pramāṇe*; read *apramāṇam eva … 'pramāṇe* (Xuanzang 無量, T1579 juan 31); printed *bhāvya* is stray and not rendered.
sbh3.2:37.3: Printed *avitarkasthānīye*; read *vitarkasthānīye* (Xuanzang 尋思, T1579 juan 31; the list at 36.5).
sbh3.2:37.5: Printed *maitrīṁ manasikṛtya*; read *maitrīm amanasikṛtya*, Xuanzang 不作意思惟慈愍 (T1579 juan 31). Printed text omits the next clause; Xuanzang has 而於瞋相作意思惟.
sbh3.2:37.14: Printed *apratiyogo*; read *atiprayogo* (Xuanzang 太過加行, T1579 juan 31; cf. 37.2); printed *pratiṣedhaḥ* is rendered as the *pratipakṣaḥ* of 37.15–37.17.
sbh3.2:37.15: Printed *pratipannaḥ* before *yo 'rdhaprayogaḥ*; not in Xuanzang (T1579 juan 31); not rendered.
sbh3.2:37.21: Printed *tāvac chamathabāhulyaṁ, sā khalv eṣā vipaśyanā jñeyā* between *saṁkleśataḥ* and *kṛṣṇapakṣataḥ*; the clause belongs to 38.1, where Xuanzang has it (T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:38.1: The śamatha clause is printed inside 37.21 and rendered here (Xuanzang 令奢摩他亦有眾多); printed *nānyādanantā*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 由所知境無邊際故，當知其量亦無邊際 (T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:38.6: Printed text pairs *cittaikāgratā* with *pratyakṣajñānotpattiḥ*; Xuanzang pairs one-pointedness with pliancy of body and mind (38.4–38.5) and makes direct knowledge their result (T1579 juan 31).
sbh3.2:38.14: Printed *tadekadhātukatā kāyacittaprabhedasaṁjñā … na tv eva cittasaṁjñā*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 非一界性身聚差別相想顯現，非身聚想 (T1579 juan 31); *citta* is not rendered.
sbh3.2:39.1: Printed *mitrībhūte* (39.1, 39.7); read *miśrībhūte* (Xuanzang 和合, T1579 juan 31). Printed *niyatāntaṁ* (39.1) and *yathaiva śamatham āsate* (39.7), corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 齊何 / 齊此, the question that 39.3 *āha* answers (cf. 38.7 *kiyatā*).
sbh3.2:40.3: Printed *pacchaiḥ pakṣaiḥ*; the list of six needs *vastu* (Xuanzang 事, T1579 juan 31; cf. 4.1).
sbh3.2:40.4: Printed *viparyayaḥ*; read *aviparyayaḥ* (Xuanzang 無顛倒, T1579 juan 31; 30.3).
sbh3.2:40.5: Printed text repeats the pāda of 40.4, then *tuṣṭir*; read *atuṣṭir* (Xuanzang 無厭足, T1579 juan 31; 30.4).
sbh3.2:41.15: Printed *cittena tathādhyātmaṁ saṁśayam iti saṁśamayati*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 內靜心 (T1579 juan 31; cf. 41.16).
sbh3.2:42.1: Printed *katamaḥ*; not in Xuanzang (T1579 juan 31); the sentence is a statement, as 42.5.
sbh3.2:42.7: Printed *trividhāḥ — catvāro*; read *trividhāḥ* (Xuanzang 三種, T1579 juan 31); the four of 42.12 are 42.8–42.11.
sbh3.2:43.3: Printed *vipratisāra-*; read *avipratisāra-* (Xuanzang 無悔, T1579 juan 31; 47.6–47.7).
sbh3.2:46.8: Printed *bhojana-*; read *bhoga-* (Xuanzang 財寶, T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:46.10: Printed *anya-rairapi*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 亦非他人，即汝自身 (T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:46.12: Printed *jāti-*; read *jñāti-* (Xuanzang 眷屬, T1579 juan 32; cf. an5.130:1.3 *ñātibyasanaṁ, bhogabyasanaṁ, rogabyasanaṁ, sīlabyasanaṁ, diṭṭhibyasanaṁ*).
sbh3.2:46.18: Printed *akriyā*; read *antakriyā* (Xuanzang 作邊際, T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:47.5: Printed *kaccin me vipratisāra*; read *me 'vipratisāra* (Xuanzang 清淨無悔, T1579 juan 32; cf. 47.6); the first *na* of *evaṁ na te* is not rendered (Xuanzang 汝於如是正觀察時).
sbh3.2:47.7: Printed *dvayā-*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 清淨 (T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:47.10: Printed *dharme prāptasya*; read *dharme 'prāptasya* (43.5; Xuanzang 未得, T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:47.11: Printed *paracittasya*; read *parīttasya* (Xuanzang 少分, T1579 juan 32; 47.9).
sbh3.2:48.5: Printed *vipakṣebhyaḥ*; read *vitarkebhyaḥ* (Xuanzang 尋思, T1579 juan 32; 48.6).
sbh3.2:48.10: Printed *nimittasaṁjñayā nirnimitte … nairvṛtya-aśubha-*; read *nirnimittasaṁjñayā, nirnimitte … nirvṛti-sukha-* (Xuanzang 無相想；於無相中 … 寂滅樂想, T1579 juan 32); the same at 49.5.
sbh3.2:49.2: Printed *kāṣṭhaśmaśāna-*; read *kāṣṭhapāṣāṇa-* (Xuanzang 木、石, T1579 juan 32; 11.16).
sbh3.2:49.5: Printed text lists five of the six; Xuanzang adds 無相想 (T1579 juan 32); printed *nairvṛtya-aśubha-*, as at 48.10.
sbh3.2:49.8: Printed *sukham ādarśayanti*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 如鏡中面所緣影像 (T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:50.12: The clause glossed here is not in the citation at 50.2; Xuanzang has it (T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:51.6: Printed *pramāṇākāreṇa pūrvāṁ*; read *apramāṇākāreṇa pūrṇāṁ* (Xuanzang 無量行遍一切處, T1579 juan 32; cf. 54.6); printed *dvau tadā dvau* is rendered once.
sbh3.2:51.13: Printed *manaskāraṁ*; read *adhimuktimanaskāraṁ* (Xuanzang 勝解作意, T1579 juan 32; cf. 51.8).
sbh3.2:51.15: Printed *na tāvat kālakaraṇīyaṁ bhavati*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 若纔於此乃至勵力方現在前 (T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:51.16: Printed *saṁśamya vimoktavyās*; read *saṁśamo 'dhimoktavyaḥ* (Xuanzang 復應發起寂靜勝解, T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:52.3: Printed *samyagābhāsaḥ … viśiṣṭatā bhaviṣyati, pracurābhāsagatā ca*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 其相闇昧 … 亦不分明 (T1579 juan 32), the contrary of 52.4.
sbh3.2:52.15: Printed *adhyātmabahirdhā* (52.15), *bahirdhā* (52.19); read *adhyātmaṁ*, *adhyātmabahirdhā* (Xuanzang 於內, 於內外, T1579 juan 32; as 52.7–52.11).
sbh3.2:52.16: Printed *sādhruvatām*; read *adhruvatām* (Xuanzang 其性無常, T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:52.18: Printed *saṁkalpe*; read *savikalpe* (Xuanzang 有分別, T1579 juan 32; cf. 52.13).
sbh3.2:53.1: Printed *tannityena … tatprābhāreṇa*; read *tannimnena … tatprāgbhāreṇa* (Xuanzang 隨順、趣向、臨入, T1579 juan 32; cf. 30.23).
sbh3.2:53.2: Printed *kurarasya … arakṣitas*; read *kukkurasya … rakṣitas* (Xuanzang 惡狗 … 善護己身, T1579 juan 32; cf. 53.4).
sbh3.2:53.3: Printed *prerayitavyāni … anābhogatayā asaṁvṛtāni*; read *na prerayitavyāni … anābhogatayā saṁvṛtāni* (Xuanzang 不應策發諸根 … 不作功用，善守諸根, T1579 juan 32; cf. 53.4).
sbh3.2:53.4: Printed *mitabhāgīṇī*; read *mitabhāṇī* (Xuanzang 說應量語, T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:53.7: Printed *na tvam evaṁcārī … me adya … pratanukāritayā vā, antakāritayā ca*; read *tvam evaṁcārī … niṣadya … pratatakāritayā vā, atyantakāritayā ca* (Xuanzang 如是行已 … 結跏趺坐 … 由恒常作及畢竟作, T1579 juan 32; cf. 53.10).
sbh3.2:53.8: Printed *pramāṇayoga-*; read *prahāṇayoga-* (Xuanzang 斷瑜伽, T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:53.9: Printed *mauntike*; read *mauhūrtike* (Xuanzang 須臾頃, T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:53.10: Printed *abādhako*; read *ārādhako* (Xuanzang 必當獲得, T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:54.4: Printed text omits the enemy-side between *mitrapakṣād* and *udāsīnapakṣāc ca*; Xuanzang has 親品、怨品及中庸品 (T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:54.5: Printed *sukhakāyāḥ*; read *sukhakāmāḥ* (Xuanzang 求樂, T1579 juan 32; cf. 54.9).
sbh3.2:54.11: Printed *mayābhihitasukhopasaṁhāra-*; read *mayā hitasukhopasaṁhāra-* (Xuanzang 利益安樂, T1579 juan 32; cf. 54.5).
sbh3.2:54.17: Printed *anukampitāḥ*; read *nānukampitāḥ* (Xuanzang 未曾發起慈愍, T1579 juan 32); printed *cittaniṣkāluṣyakaluṣatām*, with a repeated element, is rendered as *cittaniṣkāluṣyatām*.
sbh3.2:54.18: Printed *bhūtā bhaviṣyanti, abhūvan, ye*, with stray verbs that are not rendered; Xuanzang 當令過去諸有情類皆得安樂 (T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:55.2: Printed *karmakleśahetuḥ ……*, letters illegible; Xuanzang 此煩惱、業為因緣故，感得當來純大苦蘊 (T1579 juan 32).
sbh3.2:55.4: Printed *āyatyāṁ notpadyante*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 已生、當生 (T1579 juan 32); printed *nānantāḥ paryantāḥ* is read *anantā aparyantāḥ* (無邊無際).
sbh3.2:55.5: Printed *yadi na punar*; read *yadi punar* (Xuanzang 若, without a negative, T1579 juan 32; cf. 55.7–55.8).
sbh3.2:55.7: Printed *adhyātmabahirdhā*; read *bahirdhā* (Xuanzang 於外身, T1579 juan 32; 55.8 has the inward-and-outward).
sbh3.2:55.9: Printed text omits *śaṅkha*; supplied from the MS (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (72) n. 4; Xuanzang 螺貝).
sbh3.2:55.10: Printed *abdhau*, *bhūrāviṣṭebhyo vā sarvebhyaḥ*, *prasrayebhyaś ca no*; MS *greṣce*, *jvarāviṣṭebhyo vā sattvebhyaḥ*, *praśrayebhyaḥ tathā*, and the edition reads *grīṣme* and *pratiśrayebhyaḥ* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (72) nn. 7, 9; Xuanzang 熱時 … 窯室 … 次取其外諸大風相).
sbh3.2:55.11: Printed *astyādes tāraṇīyā vāyugatena*; MS *asphuṭā aspharaṇīyā*, and for *vāyugatena* (MS) the edition reads *rūpagatena* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (74) nn. 2–3; Xuanzang 諸聚色中孔隙窟穴). Printed *parikalpitena* with a daṇḍa before *evaṁ*; the edition reads *parikalpenaivaṁ*, opening 55.12 (p. (74) n. 8; Xuanzang 後由聞思增上力故，起細分別，取識界相).
sbh3.2:55.13: Printed *udgṛhyāpy*; MS *udgṛhyāsty* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (76) n. 2; Xuanzang 有一切識諸種子).
sbh3.2:55.14: Printed *aṅgapratyaṅgagatato arthaṁ vināpy … agatāyanapraviṣṭas truṭi-*; MS *aṅgapratyaṅgaudārikāṇy … vātāyanapraviṣṭatuṭi-* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (76) nn. 5, 8; Xuanzang 先起支節麁大勝解 … 向遊塵量).
sbh3.2:55.15: Printed *-pramāṇa-* (MS *-pramāṇu-*); read *-m apramāṇa-* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (76) n. 10; Xuanzang 無量).
sbh3.2:55.16: Printed *cārthaprabhedaparyantaḥ*; MS *dhātuprabhedaparyanto* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (76) n. 12). After *ākāśadhātoḥ punaḥ* Shukla's text (432,4) lacks about ten pages, from the space-element resolve through the *ānāpānasmṛti* beginner section to the opening of the summary; ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, pp. (78)–(88), supplies them from two manuscripts (= Xuanzang T1579 juan 32, 0463c27–0464c06). Printed *smṛtisamatāyāś* (so the MS); the edition reads *smṛtimattāyāś* (p. (88) n. 11; Xuanzang 具念).
sbh3.2:56.2: Printed *dvitīyaloke* (so the MS); read *vinīya loke* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (90) n. 2; Xuanzang 調伏世間).
sbh3.2:56.3: Printed *sūkṣmacittapraśrabdhir durupalabhyā*; MS *sūkṣmā cittapraśrabdhir … durupalakṣyā*, and the edition supplies *cittaikāgratā kāya-* after Tibetan and Xuanzang 心一境性、身心輕安 (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (90) nn. 4–5).
sbh3.2:56.5: Printed *pūrva-nirgaurava-pratibhāsam*; MS *mūrdhani gauravapratibhāsam* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (90) n. 15; Xuanzang 於其頂上似重); the opening *na* has no equivalent in Tibetan or Xuanzang (n. 12) and is not rendered.
sbh3.2:56.7: Printed *vāyūr-dhva-muktāni*; MS *vāyūdṛktāni*, read *vāyūdriktāni* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (92) n. 7; Xuanzang 風大偏增).
sbh3.2:56.8: Printed *prahāṇaratirivaddakṛtakleśāpakṣya-* and *syāt …… dhyāti*; MS *prahāṇarativibandhakarakleśapakṣyam*, closing 56.7, and *sphuṭa iva khyāti* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (92) nn. 9, 11; Xuanzang 狀如充溢).
sbh3.2:56.9: Printed *cittauḍḍilyaṁ, cittadauṣṭhulyaṁ, cittasumanaskāra-*; MS *cittaudvilyaṁ ca cittasumanaskatā* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (92) nn. 13–15; Xuanzang 令心踊躍、令心悅豫).
sbh3.2:56.11: Printed *auddhatyaṁ*; MS *audvilyaṁ* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (94) n. 2; Xuanzang 踊躍).
sbh3.2:56.12: Printed *praśāntākāracittasālambane śamatho yat-tac-cayas-saḥ*; MS *praśāntākāracittam ālambane śamathopastabdhaṁ* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (94) nn. 3–4; Xuanzang 由奢摩他所攝持故，心於所緣寂靜行轉).
sbh3.2:56.14: Printed *rūpārthānurodhena*; MS *rūpāvacaro 'nena* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (94) n. 6; Xuanzang 色界定地所攝).
sbh3.2:56.17: Printed *prayoge 'sya … snigvāmā*; MS *prayogasya … snigdhā* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (94) nn. 8–9; Xuanzang 善修淨惑所緣加行 … 滋潤而轉).
sbh3.2:56.18: Printed *ābhogamātrakeṇāśakto atiprativiśodhayituṁ*; MS *śaknoti prativinodayituṁ* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (94) n. 11; Xuanzang 即能除遣).
sbh3.2:57.3: Printed *prāvivekyabhavaikatā* (57.3), *āvaraṇaśuddhayutkṛṣṭeha* (57.4); MS *prāvivekyaṁ tathaikatā*, *āvaraṇaśuddhyā kṛtveha* (ŚBh-Gr III-(6), 2013, p. (96) nn. 9–10).
